settings.heading: What is a hybrid mattress?
settings.content:
A hybrid mattress combines the responsive support of individually pocketed springs with the pressure-relieving comfort of memory foam — giving you the best of both technologies in a single mattress.

Every REM-Fit hybrid mattress is built around a core of individually wrapped pocket springs that move independently, so when your partner shifts position, you don't feel a thing. Above the springs sit layers of temperature-regulating memory foam engineered to distribute your weight evenly, easing pressure on your shoulders, hips and lower back.

Our range covers every sleep preference. The Pocket 1000 Hybrid offers an accessible entry point with 1,000 individual pocket springs and a medium-firm feel suited to most sleepers. The 4000 Ortho Elite provides firm orthopaedic support for back and joint pain sufferers, while the 5000 Lux Elite delivers a luxury sleep surface with advanced cooling gel technology for anyone who sleeps hot. For a softer, more enveloping feel, the 3000 Supreme Hybrid balances cushioned comfort with lasting support.

All our hybrid mattresses are available in single, double, king and super king sizes, come with free UK delivery, and are backed by a 100-night risk-free sleep trial and a 15-year guarantee.

Not sure which firmness suits you? Use our mattress comparison tool to find the right match for your sleep position and body type.
